svg.title: KingoMart Home: current, researched average, proposed
svg.desc: Three wireframes at 1 to 5 scale with a dashed fold line at 950 px. Current has the first product card near 2,200 px. The researched average has it near 1,060 px. The proposed Home has it at 720 px.
svg.text: Scale 1:5. KingoMart positions are CSS estimates, plus or minus 150 px.
